name: Perform Flux Balance Analysis
description: Perform Flux Balance Analysis (FBA) on a genome-scale metabolic network model and return a research log of the process and results.
detailed_description: Perform Flux Balance Analysis (FBA) on a genome-scale metabolic network model and return a research log of the process and results.
when_to_use: When you need perform flux balance analysis analysis

parameters.model_file: [Required] Path to the metabolic model file (SBML or JSON format) (str)
parameters.constraints: [Optional] Dictionary of reaction constraints where keys are reaction IDs and values are tuples of (lower_bound, upper_bound)
parameters.objective_reaction: [Optional] Reaction ID to use as the objective function (e.g., biomass reaction)
parameters.output_file: [Optional] File name to save the flux distribution results (default: fba_results.csv)
